text_en: The hand of the Lord came upon me, and he brought me out by the spirit of the Lord and set me down in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.
text_cn: 上主的手临于我，上主的神引我出去，把我放在平原中，那里布满了骨头；

text_en: He led me all around them; there were very many lying in the valley, and they were very dry.
text_cn: 他领我在骨头周围走了一遭；见平原上骨头的确很多，又很干枯。

text_en: He said to me, “Mortal, can these bones live? ” I answered, “O Lord God , you know. ”
text_cn: 他问我说：“人子，这些骨头可以复生吗？”我答说：“吾主上主！你知道。”

text_en: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to these bones, and say to them: O dry bones, hear the word of the Lord .
text_cn: 他对我说：“你向这些骨头讲预言，向他们说：干枯的骨头，听上主的话吧！

text_en: Thus says the Lord God to these bones: I will cause breath to enter you, and you shall live.
text_cn: 吾主上主对这些骨头这样说：看，我要使气息进入你们内，你们必要复活。

text_en: I will lay sinews on you, and will cause flesh to come upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and you shall live; and you shall know that I am the Lord . ”
text_cn: 我给你们放上筋，加上肉，包上皮，把气息注入你们内，你们就复活了：如此，你们便要承认我是上主。”

text_en: So I prophesied as I had been commanded; and as I prophesied, suddenly there was a noise, a rattling, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
text_cn: 于是我遵命讲预言。正当我讲预言时，忽然有一个响声，一阵震动，骨头与骨头互相结合起来。

text_en: I looked, and there were sinews on them, and flesh had come upon them, and skin had covered them; but there was no breath in them.
text_cn: 我望见他们身上有了筋，生了肉，包了皮，但他们还没有气息。

text_en: Then he said to me, “Prophesy to the breath, prophesy, mortal, and say to the breath: Thus says the Lord God : Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live. ”
text_cn: 上主对我说：“你应向气息讲预言！人子，应向气息讲预言说：吾主上主这样说：气息，你应由四方来，吹在这些被杀的人身上，使他们复活。”

text_en: I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood on their feet, a vast multitude.
text_cn: 我遵命一讲了预言，气息就进入他们内，他们遂复活了，并且站了起来；实在是一支极庞大的军队。

text_en: Then he said to me, “Mortal, these bones are the whole house of Israel. They say, ‘Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are cut off completely. ’
text_cn: 上主对我说：“人子，这些骨头就是以色列家族。他们常说：我们的骨头干枯了，绝望了，我们都完了！

text_en: Therefore prophesy, and say to them, Thus says the Lord God : I am going to open your graves, and bring you up from your graves, O my people; and I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
text_cn: 为此，你向他们讲预言说：吾主上主这样说：看，我要亲自打开你们的坟墓；我的百姓，我要从你们的坟墓中把你们领出来，引你们进入以色列地域。

text_en: And you shall know that I am the Lord , when I open your graves, and bring you up from your graves, O my people.
text_cn: 我的百姓！当我打开你们的坟墓，把你们从坟墓内领出来的时候，你们便承认我是上主。

text_en: I will put my spirit within you, and you shall live, and I will place you on your own soil; then you shall know that I, the Lord , have spoken and will act, says the Lord . ”
text_cn: 我要把我的神注入你们内，使你们复活，叫你们安居在你们的地域内，那时，你们便要承认我，上主言出必行 —— 吾主上主的断语。”

text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, take a stick and write on it, “For Judah, and the Israelites associated with it”; then take another stick and write on it, “For Joseph (the stick of Ephraim) and all the house of Israel associated with it”;
text_cn: “人子，你拿一块木头，上面写：‘犹大和他的同族以色列子民。’再拿另一块木头，上面写：‘若瑟 —— 厄弗辣因的木头 —— 和他的同族的以色列子民。’

text_en: and join them together into one stick, so that they may become one in your hand.
text_cn: 以后，你把两块木头连成一块，在你手中成为一块。

text_en: And when your people say to you, “Will you not show us what you mean by these? ”
text_cn: 若你民族的子民询问你说：这是什么意思，你不能告诉我们吗？

text_en: say to them, Thus says the Lord God : I am about to take the stick of Joseph (which is in the hand of Ephraim) and the tribes of Israel associated with it; and I will put the stick of Judah upon it, and make them one stick, in order that they may be one in my hand.
text_cn: 你要回答他们说：吾主上主这样说：看，我要拿若瑟的 —— 即在厄弗辣因手中的 —— 和他的同族以色列支派的木头，将它同犹大的木头连结为一块木头，在我手中只成为一块。

text_en: When the sticks on which you write are in your hand before their eyes,
text_cn: 你应把在上面写过字的两块木头，拿在你手中，在他们面前，

text_en: then say to them, Thus says the Lord God : I will take the people of Israel from the nations among which they have gone, and will gather them from every quarter, and bring them to their own land.
text_cn: 对他们说：吾主上主这样说：看，我要把以色列子民从他们所到的异民中领出，把他们由各方聚集起来，引他们回到自己的地域；

text_en: I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king over them all. Never again shall they be two nations, and never again shall they be divided into two kingdoms.
text_cn: 我要使他们在那地和以色列山上成为一个民族，他们只有一位国王，不再是两个民族，不再分为两个国家；

text_en: They shall never again defile themselves with their idols and their detestable things, or with any of their transgressions. I will save them from all the apostasies into which they have fallen, and will cleanse them. Then they shall be my people, and I will be their God.
text_cn: 他们也不再为他们的偶像、怪物和各种邪恶所玷污；我要把他们由他们因背约所犯的各种罪过中救拔出来，净化他们，成为我的民族，我作他们的天主。

text_en: My servant David shall be king over them; and they shall all have one shepherd. They shall follow my ordinances and be careful to observe my statutes.
text_cn: 我的仆人达味要作他们的国王，他们全体只有一个牧人；他们要遵行我的法律，谨守我的诫命，且一一实行；

text_en: They shall live in the land that I gave to my servant Jacob, in which your ancestors lived; they and their children and their children’s children shall live there forever; and my servant David shall be their prince forever.
text_cn: 他们要安居在我赐给我的仆人雅各伯，即他们的祖先所居住的地方；他们、他们的儿子，他们的子子孙孙直到永远住在那里；我的仆人达味永远作他们的领袖。

text_en: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will bless them and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary among them forevermore.
text_cn: 我要同他们订立和平的盟约，同他们订立永远的盟约；我要厚待他们，使他们昌盛，且在他们中立我的圣所，直到永远。

text_en: My dwelling place shall be with them; and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
text_cn: 我的住所也设在他们中间；我要作他们的天主，他们要作我的百姓。

text_en: Then the nations shall know that I the Lord sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary is among them forevermore.
text_cn: 当我的圣所永远在他们中间时，异民便承认我是祝圣以色列的天主。”
